chapter_name: 4.7.1 平行截面面积为已知的立体体积
source_html: 4.7.1 平行截面面积为已知的立体体积(5题).html

questions.prompt_html: \text{两个半径为}a\text{的直交圆柱体所围成立体的体积为（ ）}

options.label: A
options.html: \, 8 \! \int _ { 0 } ^ { a } \! \left( a ^ { 2 } - x ^ { 2 } \right) d x

options.label: B
options.html: \,4 \int_{0}^{a} \Bigl( a^{2}-x^{2} \Bigr) dx

options.label: C
options.html: 2 \int_{0}^{a} \left( a^{2} - x^{2} \right) dx \, .

options.label: D
options.html: \overline{ \int_{0}^{a} \left( a^{2}-x^{2} \right) dx}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{如图所示，} \\ \text{截面为垂直于} x \text{轴的平面所截立体图形的截面，其截面的面积} \\ S\left(x\right)=\sqrt{a^{2}-x^{2}}\bullet \sqrt{a^{2}-x^{2}}=a^{2}-x^{2} \\ \text{由对称性，所求体积}V=8\int_{0}^{a}S\left(x\right)dx=8\int_{0}^{a}\left(a^{2}-x^{2}\right)dx \end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {连接坐标原点}O \text {及点}p(h,r) \text {的直线、直线}x=h \text {及}x \text {轴围成一个直交三角形，将它绕}x \text {轴} \\ \text {旋转构成一个底半径为}r, \text {高为}h \text {的圆锥体，则圆锥体的体积为（）} \end{array}

options.label: A
options.html: h \pi r ^ { 2 }

options.label: B
options.html: \frac { h \pi r ^ { 2 } } { 2 }

options.label: C
options.html: \frac { h \pi r ^ { 2 } } { 3 }

options.label: D
options.html: \frac { h \pi r ^ { 2 } } { 4 }

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\text{体积微元：} \quad&dV=\pi\left(\frac{r}{h}x\right)^2 dx \quad \\ \text{所求体积：} \quad&V=\int_0^h \pi\left(\frac{r}{h}x\right)^2 dx=\frac{\pi r^2}{h^2}\left[\frac{x^3}{3}\right]\Big|_0^h=\frac{h\pi r^2}{3}\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{设有一容器，它的内壁是曲线}z=y^{2}z\text{轴旋转而成的曲面，原来盛有}8\pi m^{3}\text{的水}，\text{后来又注入}64\pi m^{3}\text{的水}，\text{设此水面比原来升高了}hm，\text{则}h=（）

options.label: A
options.html: 8

options.label: B
options.html: .7

options.label: C
options.html: 10

options.label: D
options.html: ^ 9

questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \int_{0}^{l} \pi z dz = \frac{\pi l^{2}}{2}, \frac{\pi l^{2}}{2} = 8 \pi , \text{所以} l = 4 , \text{再次注入水后，此时水面高度为} (4+h) m , \text{有} \\ \int_{4}^{4+h} \pi z dz = 64 \pi , \text{解得} h = 8 。 \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \text{底面由圆}x^{2}+y^{2}=4\text{围成，且垂直于}x\text{轴的所有截面都是正方形的立体体积为（ ）}

options.label: A
options.html: 85 \frac{1}{3}

options.label: B
options.html: 42 \frac{2}{3}

options.label: C
options.html: 32\frac{1}{3}

options.label: D
options.html: 16 \frac{2}{3}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {积分区间为[0,2],取} x \text {轴上的长度微元区间}\left[ x,x+\Delta x\right], \text {则体积微元可近似为一个底面为正方形 的长方体，体积为} dV=\left(2\sqrt{4-x^{2}}\right)^{2} dx=\left(16-4x^{2}\right) dx, \text {所以整体体积为} \\ 2\int_{0}^{2}\left(16-4x^{2}\right) dx=2\left(16x-\frac{4}{3}x^{3}\right)\bigg|_{0}^{2}=42\frac{2}{3} \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \frac { x ^ { 2 } } { a ^ { 2 } } + \frac { y ^ { 2 } } { b ^ { 2 } } = 1 , \text {则此正椭圆锥体的体积为（ ）}

options.label: A
options.html: \int_{0}^{h} \pi a b \left( 1 + \frac{2z}{h} \right)^{2} dz

options.label: B
options.html: \int_{0}^{h} \pi a b \left( 1 - \frac{z}{h} \right)^{2} dz

options.label: C
options.html: \int_{0}^{h} \pi a b \left( 1 - \frac{2z}{h} \right) dz

options.label: D
options.html: \int_{0}^{h} \pi a b \left( 1 + \frac{z}{h} \right)^{2} dz

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{截面法} \\ \text{以此圆锥体的底面中心为原点建立坐标系，以} z \text{为积分变量，积分区域为} [0,h], \text{考察微元} \\ [z,z+dz] \text{所对应的小薄片可近似为扁椭圆柱体，底面面积为} \\ \pi \frac{ab}{h^2} \bigl( h-z \bigr)^2 = \pi ab \biggl( 1-\frac{z}{h} \biggr)^2, \text{微元的体积为} dV = \pi ab \biggl( 1-\frac{z}{h} \biggr)^2 dz, \text{该椭圆锥体的体积为} \\ V = \int_0^h \pi ab \biggl( 1-\frac{z}{h} \biggr)^2 dz \, 。 \end{aligned}
